name: Honda CB250 / CL250 twin
engine: 249 cc air-cooled SOHC parallel twin, two carbs, five-speed
intro: The 250 version of the CB350 twin. Two carbs, points and a lot of shared parts with the 350.

B: It runs points ignition. Clean, gap and time the points before you chase a carb problem.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
